howto.name: Enter the data to encode
howto.text: The string or number you want to encode. Format limits vary (e.g. EAN-13 needs exactly 12-13 digits).

howto.name: Choose barcode type
howto.text: Code 128 (most flexible), Code 39, EAN-13 (retail), UPC-A (US retail), QR code (also available via the QR tool).

howto.name: Download as PNG
howto.text: Configurable size; ready for printing on labels or embedding in documents.

faq.q: What barcode type for a URL?
faq.a: Use QR code — barcodes like Code 128 work for text but are much wider for the same content.
Yes — barcodes are rendered at the standard 2D module size. Printed at 100% on a regular printer, any standard scanner reads them.

faq.q: Can I include a check digit?
faq.a: EAN-13 and UPC-A auto-calculate the check digit. Code 128 has a built-in checksum. Code 39 supports optional checksums.
